datasets.name: APEX-seq
datasets.how: APEX2 placed in eight compartments labels the RNAs around it; an RNA belongs to a compartment when it is labelled more than in the control (FDR < 0.05)

datasets.name: Nuclear-body APEX2-seq
datasets.how: APEX2 on markers of speckles, the lamina and nuclear bodies; an RNA belongs to a body when it is labelled at least twice as much as by nucleoplasmic APEX2 in both replicates

datasets.name: TSA-seq
datasets.how: tyramide signal spreading from speckles (SON) and from the lamina (lamin B) marks DNA by its distance; a gene lies near when its signal is in the top tenth of the genome

test_fields: bound by methylated proteins (ref_tests: by eCLIP proteins without a methylarginine)
gene_fields: category indices in each map of maps
expression decile among the genes each map places (0-9; x no value; - not placed)
rbp_fields: indices of the genes its eCLIP targets (ENCODE and ENCORE)
